summary: A searchable command dialog, grouped, with optional per-item descriptions, shortcuts and icons.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The trigger button's label. A search glyph is always drawn beside it.

props.name: groups

items.label: Search
items.description: Look through every file at once

props.description: Each group's `label` and its `items`. An item takes `id`, `label`, and optional `description`, `shortcut`, `icon` and `onSelect`. A divider is drawn between groups automatically.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when the query matches nothing.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Which end of an item its `icon` sits at. A `shortcut` always trails regardless.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the trigger, the popup and its items.

props.name: animated
props.description: The backdrop's fade and the popup's scale-in. Turn it off for an instant palette, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the popup is rendered. Defaults to `document.body`, which is right almost always; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame or a container that owns its own stacking context.

props.name: focusOutline
props.description: The focus outline, on by default. `false` removes it, including the danger, error and success tints that ride with it. Nothing then marks where the keyboard is unless `focusClassName` puts something back, which fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.name: focusClassName
props.description: Yumma CSS utilities merged into the focus outline on every focusable part of the component, so an `fv:oc-*`, `fv:ow-*` or `fv:oo-*` you pass wins. `className` reaches the root only, which is why this is separate.
